meaning: if that's the case / if it is… / speaking of… (contextual conditional)
gist: なら picks up a topic or assumption from the conversation — "if that's what you mean / if you're going to…". Nouns attach without だ. Advice after なら often happens before the planned action (time can reverse).

rows: [寿司|すし]なら / [週末|しゅうまつ]なら
formation.note: Nouns take bare なら (*雨だなら is wrong — contrast 雨だったら for たら). のなら softens or clarifies "if it is the case that…". Do not use ます before なら (*行きますなら).

explanation: なら reacts to something already on the table — the listener's plan, a mentioned noun, or an assumed fact. 日本へ行くなら、京都がおすすめです offers advice given that plan. Time order can reverse: 日本へ行くなら、JRパスを買ったほうがいい — you buy the pass before going. Nouns attach directly (寿司なら…); *寿司だなら is ungrammatical. Past clauses work too: もう食べたなら、片付けてね. Compared with たら ("after A, then B") and ば (condition-focused), なら is the "given that / speaking of" conditional.

senses.label: Given your plan / topic
senses.body: Also: [彼|かれ]が[来|く]るなら、[私|わたし]も[参加|さんか]します。
senses.example_ruby: [日本|にほん]へ[行|い]くなら、[京都|きょうと]がおすすめです。
senses.example_en: If you are going to Japan, I recommend Kyoto.

senses.label: Noun topic (no だ)
senses.body: Bare noun + なら = "if it's X / if you mean X".
senses.example_ruby: [寿司|すし]なら、[駅|えき]の[前|まえ]の[店|みせ]がおいしいよ。
senses.example_en: If you want sushi, the shop in front of the station is delicious.

senses.label: Time-reversed advice
senses.body: Advice or preparation often comes before the なら action — unlike たら's "after completion" order.
senses.example_ruby: [日本|にほん]へ[行|い]くなら、JRパスを[買|か]ったほうがいい。
senses.example_en: If you're going to Japan, you'd better buy a JR Pass (buy before going).

senses.label: Reacting to a stated feeling / fact
senses.body: のなら often clarifies "if that's the case".
senses.example_ruby: [行|い]きたくないなら、[無理|むり]をしなくてもいいよ。
senses.example_en: If you don't want to go, you don't have to force yourself.

register_context: なら is everyday in advice and topic-picking replies. のなら can sound a bit more explanatory or soft. Casual noun なら is very common (寿司なら…). だったら can also pick up a topic in colloquial speech (寿司だったら…); なら is the standard topic-picking form and だったら is a casual alternative. For "call me when you arrive," use たら, not なら.

mistakes.wrong_ruby: [雨|あめ]だなら、ピクニックは[中止|ちゅうし]です。
mistakes.right_ruby: [雨|あめ]なら、ピクニックは[中止|ちゅうし]です。
mistakes.why: Nouns attach to なら without だ (*雨だなら). For たら, use 雨だったら instead.

mistakes.wrong_ruby: [日本|にほん]へ[行|い]きますなら、[京都|きょうと]がおすすめです。
mistakes.right_ruby: [日本|にほん]へ[行|い]くなら、[京都|きょうと]がおすすめです。
mistakes.why: なら follows the plain form (行くなら), never ます (*行きますなら).

mistakes.wrong_ruby: [日本|にほん]へ[行|い]ったら、JRパスを[買|か]ったほうがいい。
mistakes.right_ruby: [日本|にほん]へ[行|い]くなら、JRパスを[買|か]ったほうがいい。
mistakes.why: (Meaning "Buy a JR Pass before going.") Time-reversed prep advice uses なら; 行ったら means after you have gone.

contrasts.label: なら vs たら
contrasts.summary: なら: given the plan/topic, advice may come first. たら: B after A is completed; also past discovery.
contrasts.ex_a_ruby: [日本|にほん]へ[行|い]くなら、JRパスを[買|か]ったほうがいい。
contrasts.ex_a_en: If you're going, you'd better buy a JR Pass first (なら)
contrasts.ex_b_ruby: [日本|にほん]へ[行|い]ったら、[京都|きょうと]に[寄|よ]ってください。
contrasts.ex_b_en: When you go to Japan, please stop by Kyoto (たら · after going)

contrasts.label: なら vs ば
contrasts.summary: なら picks up conversational context; ば states a general/hypothetical condition (and regret ばよかった).
contrasts.ex_a_ruby: [寿司|すし]なら、[駅|えき]の[前|まえ]の[店|みせ]がおいしいよ。
contrasts.ex_a_en: If it's sushi, that shop is good (なら · topic)
contrasts.ex_b_ruby: もっと[早|はや]く[出発|しゅっぱつ]すればよかった。
contrasts.ex_b_en: I wish I had left earlier (ばよかった)

contrasts.label: なら vs と
contrasts.summary: と = natural/habitual consequence (present/future only), no request/volition in the main clause. なら is contextual advice/topic, not a law-like consequence.
contrasts.ex_a_ruby: [週末|しゅうまつ]なら、[時間|じかん]があります。
contrasts.ex_a_en: If it's the weekend, I have time (なら · topic)
contrasts.ex_b_ruby: [春|はる]になると、[桜|さくら]が[咲|さ]く。
contrasts.ex_b_en: When spring comes, the cherries bloom (と · habitual/natural)

contrasts.label: Noun なら vs だったら
contrasts.summary: なら is the standard topic-picking form. だったら (たら pattern) is a natural casual alternative for the same topic-picking job, and also covers "if it turns out to be…".
contrasts.ex_a_ruby: [寿司|すし]なら、[駅|えき]の[前|まえ]の[店|みせ]がおいしいよ。
contrasts.ex_a_en: If it's sushi (standard topic なら)
contrasts.ex_b_ruby: [寿司|すし]だったら、[駅|えき]の[前|まえ]の[店|みせ]がおいしいよ。
contrasts.ex_b_en: If it's sushi (casual topic だったら — also fine)

checks.prompt: 日本へ行く（　）、JRパスを買ったほうがいい。
checks.why: Prep advice before the trip (time-reversed) → なら. 行ったら would mean after going; ば/と don't fit this contextual advice.

checks.prompt: 寿司（　）、駅の前の店がおいしいよ。
checks.why: Noun topic-picking → bare なら (seed cloze). *だなら and *だば are ungrammatical.

checks.prompt: もう食べた（　）、片付けてね。
checks.why: Reacting to an assumed past fact → なら / のなら (seed). と cannot take a request; bare ば doesn't fit this topic-reaction.
